summary: Operational memory initialized for Didier rationalization.
action: Create canonical incident journal and use it for future regressions.

summary: False ASR warn, temporary NPU block on missing YOLO26 HEF, and false audio queue failure during E2E validation.
action: Reloaded didier-asr and didier-api, kept YOLO26 support code in the active vision path without forcing a missing HEF, and raised audio queue IPC timeouts so healthy UDS audio worker calls no longer fail under TENDU mode.

summary: YOLO26 artifacts generated up to ONNX, but HEF compilation is blocked on this machine.
action: Ultralytics and ONNX were installed, yolo26n.pt and yolo26n.onnx were generated, but no local Hailo Dataflow Compiler is installed (`hailo_compile`/`hailomz` absent, `hailo` CLI is runtime-only). Compile the ONNX on a machine with the Hailo DFC, then place the resulting HEF in models/hailo/.

summary: Externally compiled yolo26n.hef was supplied and deployed, clearing the prior YOLO26 build blocker for runtime activation.
action: Copied /home/tchernobog/yolo26n.hef to /mnt/didier_ssd/didier/models/hailo/yolo26n.hef, restarted didier-api, confirmed /vision/status reports model=yolo26n.hef with npu_active=true and non-empty detections, then re-ran scripts/validate_chat_e2e.py successfully.

summary: YOLO26 false micro-detections were traced to an incorrect raw-head decoder, then real object detections were restored after fixing decoder + preprocessing + threshold.
scope: tentacles/vision.py / config/config.json / yolo26n.hef / primary vision stream
action: Patched the active Hailo decoder to pair raw 4-channel box heads with 80-channel class heads per stride, apply class-aware NMS, and expose detector_debug in /vision/status. Then switched YOLO26 preprocessing from stretch-resize to letterbox and reduced vision.npu_score_threshold from the default 0.35 to 0.15 for this HEF. Result: /vision/detections again returns real Hailo detections (latest confirmed example: person with confidence 0.5) instead of only fake top-left boxes or OpenCV fallback shapes.

summary: Surface stream stutter and mismatched PS3/Surface Hailo feedback were traced to the remote MJPEG HTTP emitter following arbitration FPS instead of the configured remote-stream cadence.
action: Locked secondary detection polling and thresholds to the active Hailo path, then fixed the remote MJPEG HTTP generator to honor the configured Surface stream FPS even in TENDU mode. Validation window after v4r36: `/vision/status-secondary` healthy at 15 fps, both `/vision/detections` and `/vision/detections-secondary` returned the same semantic class (`personne`), and `/metrics` exposed live Hailo activity via estimated utilization plus real_fps.

summary: Xiaomi/Yeelight actuator states diverged from reality after bulb IP drift and incomplete discovery runs corrupted the stored lamp bindings.
action: Hardened Yeelight reconciliation with SSDP + bounded nearby TCP scans, blocked heuristic rebinding on incomplete inventories, normalized missing hardware IDs to null, repaired the stored lamp/IP bindings, and revalidated live state on all six lamps. The six-lamp manual green sync on 2026-03-01 now serves as the canonical actuator baseline (`#00FF03`, bright 80).
